iti100:2.1: ahamasmi bhikkhave brāhmaṇo yācayogo sadā payatapāṇī antimadehadharo anuttaro bhisako sallakatto
iti100:2.2: tassa me tumhe puttā orasā mukhato jātā dhammajā dhammanimmitā dhammadāyādā no āmisadāyādā.
iti100:3.3: etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ dānānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammadānaṃ.
iti100:4.3: etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ saṃvibhāgānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammasaṃvibhāgo.
iti100:5.3: etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ anuggahānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammānuggaho.
iti100:6.3: etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ yāgānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammayāgoti.
iti100:8.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
